title: Ngorongoro or Serengeti: Do You Need Both?
excerpt: Many travellers ask whether they need both the Serengeti and the Ngorongoro Crater. Short answer: they complement each other.
body:
The Serengeti and Ngorongoro are neighbours, and most safaris in northern Tanzania include both. They are very different.

## The crater

- A compact area: lots of animals in a short time.
- One of the best places for black rhinos.
- One day is usually enough.
- Many vehicles in a small space.

## The Serengeti

- Enormous: space, variety and a feeling of wilderness.
- Big cats and the Great Migration.
- At least two or three nights recommended.

## Why both

The crater gives you concentrated wildlife and rhinos. The Serengeti gives you space and the migration. Ngorongoro lies on the way to the Serengeti from Arusha, so combining them is logical.

## If time is short

With only three days, choose Tarangire and Ngorongoro. With five or more, add the Serengeti. See [a three-day safari](/blog/short-safari-3-days/).

[Plan your safari with both](/travel-proposal/).
